result.summary: Adds a unit test in `coinselection_tests.cpp` to verify that `KnapsackSolver` continues evaluating candidate output groups after encountering groups that exceed the maximum selection weight. The test passes 10 overweight groups alongside one valid group and runs the randomized selection multiple times to ensure the valid coin is selected.
result.problem: Existing coin selection test coverage did not ensure that Knapsack continues searching after encountering an overweight group. If a bug or regression caused the loop to abort on an overweight group instead of skipping it, coin selection could prematurely fail whenever overweight candidates appear early in the shuffled list.
evidence: Author found a surviving mutant (`continue` replaced with `break` in `KnapsackSolver`) on the mutation testing dashboard and verified that all five wallet test suites passed with the mutant applied on master (PR description).
Author verified that applying the mutant causes the new test to fail with `critical check result has failed` (PR description).
result.scope_notes: Small, self-contained unit test addition (+19 lines in one test file).
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; the diff has been provided.
result.card: Adds a unit test to verify that the Knapsack coin selection solver continues evaluating candidate output groups after encountering overweight groups rather than prematurely aborting. Without this test, wallet test suites passed even when the loop skip logic was mutated from continue to break, which would cause coin selection to fail when overweight groups appear early in the evaluation order. The author identified the gap via mutation testing and confirmed the new test catches the surviving mutant.

risk.why: The change only adds a unit test, so a defect could at worst cause false test failures or flakiness in CI.
